album.title: Radif of Persian Music on Setar I

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on F4 and dwells most on F in Qajar. Gushe-ye Abu'ata (1:26.1) introduces Ek, centred on C. The line peaks at G4 (406.5 Hz) at 1:43.9. It closes on C3, not the tonic (G4 → Ek4 → Ek4 → C3 → C3 → C3).

flags: tonic G set in the catalog (Shur's finalis G (204.6 Hz; four of the suite's nine tracks voted it): from G the suite is Shur with its 5th lowered (0, 134, 286, 496, 627/703, 781, 990 cents). The vote picked the 4th above (C): with the 5th lowered the 4th sounds like a finalis (Farhat 1990, p. 27); read from C the 6th would be neutral (838 cents), which Shur's is not. Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 136.5 Hz (C)
